name: motion
measures: Scenario 5, content motion and cadence changes (terrain flow; the mission opens the F10 map at mission time 60-87 s, which forces 1X and back). Capture before the map, in it, and 20 s after it: the synthetic sits at the cadence fraction of the real-to-real motion (1/2; 1/3 and 2/3) within 0.15, in both layers; layer mismatch on synthetics <= 1.5 x real; at 1X every submission is a real one (no synthetic swapchain); duplicates. Flight log, outside the capture windows: repeats per second, presenter_transition 406, late first synthetics, against the twin (VERIFY-0.6.7's open defect: 39-41 fps for a minute after 1X -> 2X).
cannotJudge: The true interpolation error (DCS gives no in-between frame: use the chain probe with the capture layer for that). Judder as seen. Inside a capture window the pacing is the capture's own: read cadence numbers only outside the windows.
sideEffects: three capture windows: 1.6 + 0.2 + 1.6 GB per flight at the flown sizes
